text: {"suggestions":[{"id":"F-late-servicer-report","outcome":"query","reason":"The May servicer report, due 22 Jun 2026, has not been received despite a reminder and escalation, so the borrowing base cannot be finalised until the servicer supplies it."},{"id":"F-roll-forward","outcome":"query","reason":"The May tape omits 27 loans that were on the April tape, with no payoff or charge-off status, leaving a gap of US$412,004.04 that the borrower or servicer must explain."},{"id":"F-charge-offs","outcome":"query","reason":"Nine loans are shown as charged off in the servicer report but as live on the tape, a US$140,112.77 inconsistency that the servicer must reconcile."},{"id":"F-northmoor-delinquency","outcome":"confirmed","reason":"The 60+ day delinquency average of 5.77% sits just below the 6.0% trigger on clear terms, with the latest month at 6.60%, so the lender must be told of the near breach."},{"id":"F-bramble-leverage","outcome":"expert","reason":"Leverage is 5.28x on the balance sheet but 6.20x against the 6.00x covenant if the disclosed US$53,900 thousand off-balance-sheet guarantee counts, which turns on how the debt definition is read."},{"id":"F-shared-vin","outcome":"confirmed","reason":"The tapes show VIN 7S0GBWZ96PJAEFF0W securing both Bramble loan BAF100764 and Northmoor loan NMC303235, so the same car is pledged in two facilities and the lender must be told."},{"id":"F-kestrel-markdown","outcome":"expert","reason":"Loan-to-value rises from 30.3% to 32.2% only if the US$85m Corrin Healthcare Holdings markdown of 8 May 2026 is taken into account, and the Manager has not declared a Valuation Event, so it depends on how the valuation clause is read."},{"id":"F-kestrel-stale-valuation","outcome":"query","reason":"Harlow Logistics Group was last valued on 15 Dec 2025, 106 days before the calculation date against a 90-day limit, so the fix is a fresh valuation from the sender."}]}
